final_wiki.Q-4184:
Q-4184: How many days are there from 2024-11-05 to 2024-12-10 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 35

Calculation: November has 30 days. From Nov 5 to Nov 30 exclusive of start = 25 days (Nov 6-30). Plus Dec 1-10 = 10 days. Total = 35 days.
